text:
jess_sales: Evergreen Insurance wants a short POC. Requirements: on-prem entitlement proxy that terminates SAML, supports SCIM delta webhooks, enforces RBAC via local OPA, and keeps logs in their air-gapped network. They also want a 6-week POC price and connector setup fee. Can we list blockers?

toni_se: Quick clarifying q's: 1) SCIM delta only or full sync? 2) Is assertion export to Redwood allowed? 3) mTLS required?

jess_sales: Delta only. No assertion export unless they sign off. mTLS preferred.

nate_infra: Private deploy works as single-VM connector. We support mTLS, ACME rotation, and signed update bundles for air-gapped installs. HSM is available as an extra.

rebecca_pse: OPA pattern: local sidecar that returns allow/deny synchronously and writes decision logs locally. We can optionally ship aggregated metrics upstream when permitted.

jess_sales: They expect ~15k users, 200 churn/day. Any scaling concerns?

nate_infra: Fine but recommend durable queue on connector with 48h retention for transient issues. SCIM bulk imports will be slower over air-gap.

toni_se: SCIM subscription example (mutual TLS): POST /scim/v2/Subscriptions { callbackUrl: "https://connector.local/scim/callback", auth: "mutual_tls", filters: "Resources eq \"User\"" }

rebecca_pse: Role mapping supported: SCIM groups -> Redwood roles. Local admin overrides stored encrypted on connector; we must document conflict resolution.

legal_qa: Compliance note: storing assertions may be PII. If they want logs retained, we must add retention fields in SQA and possibly a DPA amendment.

jess_sales: Action items: nate -> SOW + ports list; rebecca -> OPA stub + role conflict doc; toni -> SCIM retry semantics; legal_qa -> SQA + DPA template. I'll set presales call Tue 10:00 PT.

compliance_bot: POC workspace created: evergreen-poc-2026. Docs folder: https://redwood.internal/pocs/evergreen (SSO access).

jess_sales: Thanks all. I'll attach customer network diagram and ask preferred cert rotation window. :white_check_mark:
